source: validated naive truncation-aware pilot5 plus exact post-hoc route B; fixed lower scale offset+6
scope: five full train-only SVHN epochs; one current E4M3 code source and two derived route-B weight modes
quantization_source: one current E4M3 source encoding per MX layer/minibatch; E2M3 highest exponent bits with scale64; E2M1 subsequent mantissa shift with same scale64
teacher_chain: labels -> E4M3 -> detached E4M3 softmax to E2M3 -> detached E2M3 softmax to E2M1
selection: all three modes at first strict E4M3 test maximum, and all three at last pilot epoch
shared_scale_policy: E4 source scale determined from current G(W); each lower scale code=source+6; promote before adding; reject overflow without clipping/wrap including zero blocks; source can change after master updates
source_cache_policy: detached integer codes shared across three passes; fresh G(W) autograd graph each pass; cache cleared before Adam
ste_policy: identity through complete route-B code path wrt G(W), no factor64 in backward; retain G(W) derivatives
bn_training_policy: three mode banks learn parameters and running statistics normally; eval frozen
research_outcome_policy: low accuracy, constant-class predictions, zero finite gradients or zero finite MX-master updates are diagnostics, not automatic failure; structural/finite/state checks mandatory
